identity.name: Pigma
identity.aesthetic_archetype: Jewel & Luxury mixed with Urban Editorial

usage_rules.headings: Use Playfair Display for all major headings (H1-H3). Use italic variants for emphasis words.
usage_rules.body: Use Manrope for all standard text. maximize readability with relaxed line-height.
usage_rules.overline: Use JetBrains Mono, Uppercase, tracking-widest (0.2em) for small labels like 'NEW DROP' or 'LIMITED EDITION'.

accent.description: Champagne Gold - Use sparingly for 'Buy Now' or 'Exclusive' badges

colors.theme_strategy: Dark Mode dominant for luxury feel, but allow Light Mode for clean e-commerce readability in product details.

grid_system.marketing: Use 'Bento' style asymmetric grids. Combine 2:1 and 1:1 aspect ratios.
grid_system.product_list: Masonry layout or strict 3-column grid with massive images.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-200 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold px-8 py-4
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4
buttons.accent: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#C5A028] font-bold rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus:border-white focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-neutral-500 font-light
inputs.filled: bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-md px-4 py-3 focus:border-white/40

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain/noise overlays (opacity 0.03) on dark backgrounds to prevent banding and add 'film' look.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge lenis @radix-ui/react-slot sonner
THEME_SETUP: Override Tailwind config to use the Palette defined in 'colors'. Set default font family to Manrope.
COMPONENT_OVERRIDE: Do not use default Shadcn cards. Implement the 'Glass Panel' style defined in 'layout.container_styles' for the Dashboard.
HEADER_LOGIC: Header must be transparent fixed at top, becoming solid black/blur on scroll.
MARKETING_PAGE: Use the 'Tetris Grid' layout. Do not just stack sections vertically. Overlap elements using negative margins.
PRODUCT_PAGE: Use a split layout. Left side: Sticky large images (vertical scroll). Right side: Sticky product details.
INFLUENCER_DASHBOARD: Use dark mode by default. High contrast data visualization. Use 'Jewel' colors for charts (Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire) instead of generic rainbow.
FORBIDDEN: Do not use generic 'Inter' font for Headings. Do not use gradients on text unless it is the specific 'Gold Rush' gradient.
TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' aesthetics (generic centered layouts, blue primary colors).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-12, p-16).
Dark colors look good independently; avoid dark gradients.
Do not use AI assistant emojis.
